why: The arrow moves round the circle clockwise: bottom, left, top, right. The small dot also moves one quarter clockwise each step (top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left, top-left) and changes colour white, black, white, black. So C has the arrow on top pointing right and a white dot in the bottom-left. That is option 5. Option 1 has the right arrow and place, but its dot is black.
trick: Track each moving part on its own: the arrow, the dot's place, and the dot's colour.
note: Option 2 has a small extra mark next to its dot in the scan; it looks like a print mark and was not drawn.
